title: Dragon Quest Builders
synopsis: Square Enix’s block-building action RPG set in an alternate Alefgard — retained as the Nintendo Switch game card.

catalog.originalTitle: ドラゴンクエストビルダーズ アレフガルドを復活せよ
catalog.mediumForm: Nintendo Switch game card · retail edition

custody.physical: Nintendo Switch game card in retail case

curatorNotes:
Dragon Quest Builders imagines the original Dragon Quest with the Dragonlord victorious: a lone Builder must restore the ruined land of Alefgard block by block. The Nintendo Switch version adds a Great Sabrecub mount and buildable Pixel Blocks.

It first released in Japan in January 2016, and on Nintendo Switch in North America on February 9, 2018.

The filing joins the Dragon Quest lineage on the shelf.
collectionNotes:
The retained object is Square Enix’s retail edition of Dragon Quest Builders on a Nintendo Switch game card.

Dedicated artifact views of the individual copy have not yet been filed; the gallery below is held open for that documentation.

preservation.playableOn: Nintendo Switch; compatible Nintendo Switch family hardware
preservation.compatibility: Nintendo Switch software is region-free. The retained game card is the primary access copy and runs on any Nintendo Switch console.
preservation.concerns: Game cards are flash media; long-term charge retention, contact wear, and loss of the small card from its case are the principal risks. Any content delivered as an eShop download or update depends on Nintendo’s servers and is not preserved by the card alone.
preservation.knownRevisions: Released in Japan on PlayStation 3, PlayStation 4, and PlayStation Vita on January 28, 2016. Nintendo Switch release in Japan on March 1, 2018, and North America on February 9, 2018 (HAC-P-ACXPB).
preservation.availability: Distributed at retail by Square Enix, with a digital edition on the Nintendo eShop.
